programme.title: E7 - Durham - Henry VIII
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette take on the stunning River Wear - a natural fortress protecting the ancient city of Durham and its sacred Cathedral. This is where in the 1500’s, Henry VIII seized power of the Church and the Cathedral’s shrines were plundered. Now Rick and Beau, joined by Durham’s diving archeologist Gary Bankhead, are hunting for hidden treasures to uncover evidence of what life was like from this majestic city’s turbulent past.

programme.title: E5 - Queensland
programme.desc: Known as ‘The Sunshine State,’ Queensland is a region of spectacular beauty and adventurous possibilities. In this episode, we highlight some of the standout activities available to visitors in this incredible state. Traverse the pristine wilderness of K’gari, the world’s largest sand island, witness the humpback whale migration from the sheltered waters of Platypus Bay, and come face to face with Australia’s cutest animals at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary.

programme.title: E6 - South Australia
programme.desc: From the ancient mountains of the Flinders Ranges to the rocky shores of the Great Australian Bight, South Australia is a land brimming with culture, history and natural wonders. In this installment, we feature the premier experiences to be had in this wonderful destination. Step onto the vast salt flats of the Gawler Ranges, fish for wild salmon from the shimmering shores of the Eyre Peninsular, and experience an iconic train journey through the outback, onboard The Ghan.

programme.title: E3 - Lions Pt 1
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. programme.title: E4 - Lions Pt 2
programme.desc: Locked in a dark cell in an illegal zoo is an adult lion who became known as Ivan -Asen. A result of generations of inbreeding at Razgrad Zoo, Bulgaria, he’s in extremely bad condition, with skeletal deformations as a result of growing up with no room to move. He was rescued by animal welfare organization, Four Paws and has been rehabilitating in Sofia Zoo. programme.title: E1 - Lost In La Pampa
programme.desc: Chef Scott and friend's first stop on their S. American tour is La Pampa, Argentina for red stag and vizcacha.

programme.title: E5 - Queensland
programme.desc: Known as ‘The Sunshine State,’ Queensland is a region of spectacular beauty and adventurous possibilities. In this episode, we highlight some of the standout activities available to visitors in this incredible state. Traverse the pristine wilderness of K’gari, the world’s largest sand island, witness the humpback whale migration from the sheltered waters of Platypus Bay, and come face to face with Australia’s cutest animals at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary.

programme.title: E6 - South Australia
programme.desc: From the ancient mountains of the Flinders Ranges to the rocky shores of the Great Australian Bight, South Australia is a land brimming with culture, history and natural wonders. In this installment, we feature the premier experiences to be had in this wonderful destination. Step onto the vast salt flats of the Gawler Ranges, fish for wild salmon from the shimmering shores of the Eyre Peninsular, and experience an iconic train journey through the outback, onboard The Ghan.

After weeks of crate training the veterinarians who specialize in large animal transports Marc and Juno are relieved that Ivan- Asen doesn’t need to be tranquilized to be moved into the crate. He walks in willingly. After beginning a life in such hellish conditions, Ivan-Asen is on the road to recovery. The team first have to navigate the Balkan Mountain ranges in the middle of winte

programme.title: E7 - Durham - Henry VIII
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette take on the stunning River Wear - a natural fortress protecting the ancient city of Durham and its sacred Cathedral. This is where in the 1500’s, Henry VIII seized power of the Church and the Cathedral’s shrines were plundered. Now Rick and Beau, joined by Durham’s diving archeologist Gary Bankhead, are hunting for hidden treasures to uncover evidence of what life was like from this majestic city’s turbulent past.

programme.title: E5 - Queensland
programme.desc: Known as ‘The Sunshine State,’ Queensland is a region of spectacular beauty and adventurous possibilities. In this episode, we highlight some of the standout activities available to visitors in this incredible state. Traverse the pristine wilderness of K’gari, the world’s largest sand island, witness the humpback whale migration from the sheltered waters of Platypus Bay, and come face to face with Australia’s cutest animals at Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary.

programme.title: E6 - South Australia
programme.desc: From the ancient mountains of the Flinders Ranges to the rocky shores of the Great Australian Bight, South Australia is a land brimming with culture, history and natural wonders. In this installment, we feature the premier experiences to be had in this wonderful destination. Step onto the vast salt flats of the Gawler Ranges, fish for wild salmon from the shimmering shores of the Eyre Peninsular, and experience an iconic train journey through the outback, onboard The Ghan.

programme.desc: Presented as a leisurely variety show, the program revolves around the theme: 'Seek Paradise Along the Journey to Kunlun Mountain.' Throughout their travels, the adventurers will uncover lesser-known towns, each exuding its own unique charm. They will explore the distinctive characteristics of these hidden gems, savoring every street and lane, as well as every bite and sip. This immersive experience seeks to rediscover the essence of life, allowing our weary hearts to shine anew amidst the dust of daily grind.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: In Hasami, Nagasaki Prefecture, ceramics are made through a division of labor among local craftspeople. Aoko (Matsui Rena), who grew up there and works as a porcelain painter, enjoys a quiet life until Tatsuki (Ichinose Hayate), a solitary potter, arrives from Finland. When he declares that his pottery needs no painted decoration, Aoko feels he is rejecting not only her work but her entire community. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

programme.title: Gen Z Actresses: The Dumpling Queen
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang Jianhe, a woman from Qingdao, was forced to leave her hometown with her two daughters. To make ends meet and raise her children, she washed dishes by day and cleaned cars by night. With no one to rely on, she bore the immense pressure alone. Determined to break free from her fate, Zang Jianhe decided to make a living by selling dumplings. From struggling to attract customers to eventually thriving, she received much support from tough-but-kind Hong Jie, Brother Hua, and Uncle Dessert. Through perseverance, she grew her dumpling business into a success, and her life gradually opened up to new possibilities... The film is based on a true story.

programme.title: E34
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Righting Wrongs
programme.desc: Ha Ling Ching, a mild-mannered prosecutor who takes the law into his own hands, when the legal system fails to capture the most notorious criminals. As the police assign a tough, gutsy inspector Cindy to stop Ha's vigilante hunting out of court, another murder brings them together in the search for the real killer, who may or may not be one of their own!

programme.title: From Riches To Rags
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

programme.title: 90’s Hotties Collection: 3 Days Of A Blind Girl
programme.desc: Heung is temporarily blinded by an accident. While her doctor husband leaves Hong Kong for a meeting, an uninvited man arrives at their house. The man teases and tortures Heung, claiming that he is coming to avenge his wife...
